name: obsidian-symlink-manager
title: Obsidian Symlink Manager
description:
Effortlessly manage, inspect, and sync symlinked Obsidian plugins, CSS snippets, and themes across multiple vaults.

⚬ Inspect & Modify: View existing symlink targets, update paths, and create or remove links on the fly.
⚬ Vault Bootstrapping: Generate new vaults with a guided setup to choose exactly which components to symlink.
⚬ Global Origin Vault: Define a primary source vault where your shared, "source-of-truth" configurations live.
⚬ Broken Link Detection: Automatically highlight and repair "dead" symlinks when source files are deleted or moved.
⚬ Sync Profiles / Presets: Allow one-click symlink sets (e.g., a minimal "Work Vault" profile vs. a fully loaded "Personal" profile).
⚬ Hot-Reload / Restart Reminder: A built-in prompt or command to reload Obsidian without saving/reopening after symlink changes.
author: axel_eklund

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
